reply.analysis: Proven: bracket 220 to 220. The upper bound is a linear code over F_5 (c=4) of length 220 that meets the lower bound; independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding all pass. Baselines: cpsat_alpha proved 220 in 12.2 s, kushagra_agent gave exact 220 (field 5) in 0.28 s, f2_minrank_sat gave no value (lower 219) in 0.86 s, and cpsat_cover (604) and frac_cover (635) were unproven at about 120 s. The agent matched the exact optimum and beat both cover baselines, but its wall time was 114.5 s (LLM 72.1 s, compute 42.4 s, warmup 9.2 s), far slower than kushagra_agent and cpsat_alpha. Nothing suspicious: the lower bound agrees with cpsat_alpha's proven value. An own_rank check is requested as a cheap independent recheck of the code length.
